{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Treat the increment as changes to the existing Spring XD codebase and its Maven-based build, rather than as a greenfield Spring application.",
    "Preserve existing public module and job configuration conventions wherever possible, adding new properties with backward-compatible defaults.",
    "Implement Avro HDFS compression as a configurable codec selection with compression disabled by default only if that matches the existing behavior; otherwise preserve the current default codec and add explicit override support.",
    "Pass JavaMail TLS and SSL settings through the existing java-mail-properties mechanism and rely on JavaMail providers and standard JavaMail property names rather than implementing custom socket handling.",
    "Expose partitionResultsTimeout through the metadata model and ensure inherited single-step partitioning jobs receive the property consistently.",
    "Upgrade Spring Boot and the listed dependency versions through the central dependency-management configuration, then resolve source, binary, configuration, and test compatibility issues.",
    "Represent deployment manifest properties in a separate YAML resource and merge or load them through the existing deployment parsing path, with explicitly supplied stream properties taking precedence.",
    "Implement message compression through a reusable compression service supporting gzip and zip, including decompression on the receiving side where required.",
    "Integrate compression into both Rabbit source and sink modules using explicit configuration properties and preserve uncompressed message compatibility.",
    "Use unit tests for module behavior, integration tests for cross-module wiring, and focused compatibility tests for dependency upgrades.",
    "Perform the work as one developer; effort includes coding, local verification, test updates, documentation, and release-quality validation but excludes elapsed waiting time for external environments."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The source repository, build, existing test suite, and module architecture are available and buildable before development begins.",
    "The requested stories are implemented in the historical Spring XD ecosystem referenced by the job, sink, source, stream, and deployment terminology.",
    "The Sqoop and jdbchdfs batch jobs and representative benchmark data are available locally or in an existing test environment; provisioning production-scale infrastructure is excluded.",
    "Benchmarking in U1 includes benchmark harness changes, repeatable test execution, collection of comparable throughput and timing statistics, and a concise report, but not long-duration performance campaigns.",
    "Existing HDFS, Avro, Rabbit, Mail, deployment, metadata, and compression extension points can be reused without redesigning the complete framework.",
    "TLS certificate management, truststore provisioning, mail-server administration, Rabbit broker administration, and external infrastructure troubleshooting are excluded.",
    "The dependency versions listed in U5 are authoritative, and any incompatibilities discovered are limited to changes reasonably attributable to this upgrade.",
    "No new user-interface work is required; configuration is exposed through existing XML, properties, metadata, or YAML mechanisms.",
    "Backward compatibility is required for existing configurations unless a story explicitly changes the default behavior.",
    "Documentation consists of configuration reference updates, examples, and upgrade notes rather than a complete rewrite of project documentation.",
    "The estimate is expressed in productive workdays and does not include project management, separate code-review staffing, or independent QA staffing."
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "A1",
      "activity_name": "Repository analysis and implementation planning",
      "activity_description": "Inspect the existing modules, build, configuration model, metadata definitions, test conventions, and integration points for all eight stories; establish the change plan and baseline test results.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A2",
      "activity_name": "Sqoop versus jdbchdfs benchmark",
      "activity_description": "Create or adapt repeatable benchmark jobs and datasets, execute comparable Sqoop and jdbchdfs batch runs, collect throughput and timing statistics, analyze results, and produce the requested comparison output.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A3",
      "activity_name": "Avro HDFS sink codec configuration",
      "activity_description": "Add configuration for disabling Snappy compression and selecting an alternate Avro codec for the hdfs-dataset sink, update validation and defaults, and add unit and integration coverage for compressed and uncompressed output.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A4",
      "activity_name": "TLS support for Mail sink",
      "activity_description": "Enable secured IMAP and SMTP connections through the existing JavaMail properties configuration, verify adapter wiring and connection behavior, and add tests and configuration examples for TLS/SSL properties.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A5",
      "activity_name": "partitionResultsTimeout metadata exposure",
      "activity_description": "Expose partitionResultsTimeout in the metadata and configuration model for jobs inheriting the single-step partitioning strategy, ensure all three identified out-of-the-box importing jobs receive it, and add metadata and execution tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "Spring Boot and dependency version upgrade",
      "activity_description": "Update Spring Boot to 1.2.0.RELEASE and apply the specified dependency versions in dependency management, including resolving dependency convergence, build, packaging, and configuration changes directly caused by the upgrade.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "Post-upgrade compatibility remediation",
      "activity_description": "Run the complete build and regression suite after the dependency upgrade, repair API or behavioral incompatibilities across modules, update affected tests and fixtures, and verify supported runtime and packaging combinations.",
      "most_likely_effort": 10
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "Separate YAML deployment manifest",
      "activity_description": "Implement loading of deployment manifest properties from a separate YAML file, define precedence and error handling, integrate it with stream deployment parsing, and add representative YAML examples and tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 7
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A9",
      "activity_name": "Reusable gzip and zip message compression",
      "activity_description": "Design and implement reusable message compression and decompression support for gzip and zip, add configuration and content handling, cover invalid and unsupported payloads, and provide unit and integration tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A10",
      "activity_name": "Rabbit source and sink compression integration",
      "activity_description": "Wire the compression capability into Rabbit source and sink modules, define source/sink configuration behavior and compatibility with uncompressed messages, and test round trips, failure handling, and both supported formats.",
      "most_likely_effort": 6
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A11",
      "activity_name": "Cross-feature integration and regression testing",
      "activity_description": "Execute the full build and regression suite, add cross-module tests for configuration metadata, deployment, messaging, HDFS output, mail connectivity mocks, and upgraded dependencies, and fix defects found during validation.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A12",
      "activity_name": "Documentation and configuration examples",
      "activity_description": "Update reference documentation and examples for Avro codecs, Mail TLS, partitionResultsTimeout, YAML manifests, message compression, Rabbit compression, and the Spring Boot dependency upgrade.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A13",
      "activity_name": "Final packaging and delivery validation",
      "activity_description": "Perform clean-build verification, inspect generated artifacts and metadata, run smoke tests using representative configurations, prepare release notes, and package the completed increment for delivery.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    }
  ],
  "reported_total": {
    "most_likely_effort": 69
  }
}

technical_and_design_decisions: Treat the increment as changes to the existing Spring XD codebase and its Maven-based build, rather than as a greenfield Spring application.
Preserve existing public module and job configuration conventions wherever possible, adding new properties with backward-compatible defaults.

Implement Avro HDFS compression as a configurable codec selection with compression disabled by default only if that matches the existing behavior; otherwise preserve the current default codec and add explicit override support.

Pass JavaMail TLS and SSL settings through the existing java-mail-properties mechanism and rely on JavaMail providers and standard JavaMail property names rather than implementing custom socket handling.
Expose partitionResultsTimeout through the metadata model and ensure inherited single-step partitioning jobs receive the property consistently.
Upgrade Spring Boot and the listed dependency versions through the central dependency-management configuration, then resolve source, binary, configuration, and test compatibility issues.
Represent deployment manifest properties in a separate YAML resource and merge or load them through the existing deployment parsing path, with explicitly supplied stream properties taking precedence.
Implement message compression through a reusable compression service supporting gzip and zip, including decompression on the receiving side where required.
Integrate compression into both Rabbit source and sink modules using explicit configuration properties and preserve uncompressed message compatibility.
Use unit tests for module behavior, integration tests for cross-module wiring, and focused compatibility tests for dependency upgrades.
Perform the work as one developer; effort includes coding, local verification, test updates, documentation, and release-quality validation but excludes elapsed waiting time for external environments.
assumptions: The source repository, build, existing test suite, and module architecture are available and buildable before development begins.
The requested stories are implemented in the historical Spring XD ecosystem referenced by the job, sink, source, stream, and deployment terminology.
The Sqoop and jdbchdfs batch jobs and representative benchmark data are available locally or in an existing test environment; provisioning production-scale infrastructure is excluded.

Benchmarking in U1 includes benchmark harness changes, repeatable test execution, collection of comparable throughput and timing statistics, and a concise report, but not long-duration performance campaigns.
Existing HDFS, Avro, Rabbit, Mail, deployment, metadata, and compression extension points can be reused without redesigning the complete framework.
TLS certificate management, truststore provisioning, mail-server administration, Rabbit broker administration, and external infrastructure troubleshooting are excluded.
The dependency versions listed in U5 are authoritative, and any incompatibilities discovered are limited to changes reasonably attributable to this upgrade.
No new user-interface work is required; configuration is exposed through existing XML, properties, metadata, or YAML mechanisms.
Backward compatibility is required for existing configurations unless a story explicitly changes the default behavior.
Documentation consists of configuration reference updates, examples, and upgrade notes rather than a complete rewrite of project documentation.
The estimate is expressed in productive workdays and does not include project management, separate code-review staffing, or independent QA staffing.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing modules, build, configuration model, metadata definitions, test conventions, and integration points for all eight stories; establish the change plan and baseline test results.

Create or adapt repeatable benchmark jobs and datasets, execute comparable Sqoop and jdbchdfs batch runs, collect throughput and timing statistics, analyze results, and produce the requested comparison output.

Add configuration for disabling Snappy compression and selecting an alternate Avro codec for the hdfs-dataset sink, update validation and defaults, and add unit and integration coverage for compressed and uncompressed output.

Enable secured IMAP and SMTP connections through the existing JavaMail properties configuration, verify adapter wiring and connection behavior, and add tests and configuration examples for TLS/SSL properties.

Expose partitionResultsTimeout in the metadata and configuration model for jobs inheriting the single-step partitioning strategy, ensure all three identified out-of-the-box importing jobs receive it, and add metadata and execution tests.

Run the complete build and regression suite after the dependency upgrade, repair API or behavioral incompatibilities across modules, update affected tests and fixtures, and verify supported runtime and packaging combinations.

Implement loading of deployment manifest properties from a separate YAML file, define precedence and error handling, integrate it with stream deployment parsing, and add representative YAML examples and tests.
